testcase.name: dictionary lookup ranks exact matches by frequency then completions
delete removes keys while composing then characters
moving the cursor by touch ends the composition without changing text
pound cycles to multi-tap where repeated presses step through letters
apostrophes are typed on one inside a word
numeric mode types digits and long press types a digit in any mode
typing composes the best word inline and highlights it
picking a suggestion commits it and learns it above the dictionary
star cycles alternatives and zero commits with a space
unknown sequences fall back to letters and are not learned
one gives punctuation attached to the previous word, repeated presses cycle it
